description: Store a GradeResult from a local check (scan_repo, check_rls, check_stripe, check_vercel_env) against the user's Securealy project so it shows in their dashboard. Sends the result and the project token (as a Bearer header) to securealy.com and nothing else. Only call this when the user has asked for the result to be posted.

result.description: The GradeResult object returned by a local check tool.

name: post_result
title: Post a local result to Securealy
